study: Second external validation of four matched half-width guarded policies on previously unused wide UCI classification sources

cnae.target: CNAE economic activity of a Brazilian business description; 856 released word frequencies; no company ID.

ozone.attribution: K. Zhang, W. Fan and X. Yuan (2008)
ozone.target: Published eight-hour peak ground-ozone indicator in the Houston area; use numeric weather features, remove date; score succeeding dated records.

parkinson.attribution: C. Sakar, G. Serbes, A. Gunduz, H. Nizam and B. Sakar (2018)
parkinson.target: Parkinson diagnosis for 252 participants in one clinical cohort; mean acoustic features across the three sustained-vowel recordings within each ID. Exclude subject ID and sex. No recording or patient spans partitions.

secom.target: Pass/fail yield for one production entity under semiconductor line testing. Use all released sensor columns, timestamp only for splitting.

semeion.target: Released one-hot handwritten digit identity from 256 binary pixels. Source does not supply writer IDs. Estimate random-image performance only. Distinct acquisition from the historical digits tasks.

urban.target: Nine published urban land-cover classes in a single high-resolution aerial image; use all features common to released official training and testing files by column name. No claim about transfer to a new city.

license: All six UCI repository pages specify CC BY 4.0. Attribute creators and DOI above. Preserve archive SHA-256 and list members used. Do not redistribute raw source files.
selection: Purposive panel fixed by documented real-world original targets, at least 50 numeric predictors per source, distinct UCI cohorts, accessible files, and feasible size for this recipe. Historical thesis configs, experiments, study inventory and evidence searched for cohort aliases; none previously used. Five non-digit domains. Record every planned fold, including infeasible folds with reasons; no replacements or outcome-based exclusions.
outer: Stratified 3-fold shuffle seed 20261115 for CNAE, Semeion and patient-aggregated Parkinson. Urban uses one official train/test split. For Ozone and SECOM use three expanding-origin splits: sort unique timestamps, development precedes cutoffs at floor(0.4*T), floor(0.6*T), and floor(0.8*T), testing up to floor(0.6*T), floor(0.8*T) and T respectively. Keep equal timestamps intact in all splits. No shuffling time series.
inner: For random and official sources, split development into 75% fit and 25% ranking using stratification and seed 20421+fold. Split ranking equally into proposal/guard stratified with seed 39823+fold. For dated sources, split the ordered development timestamps at floor(.75*D) and floor(.875*D) into consecutive fit/proposal/guard sections. Every partition must contain every published class; retain an infeasibility receipt if not. Do not redraw. Binary positive label is the minority in fit (tie uses larger original class).
algorithm: Directly reuse transport_predict.policy/predict_fold and archived reference models; no tuning. Gain prefix, discrete worst-restoration four-panel vote, continuous worst-restoration third-largest of four joint slacks, and first-panel empty-restoration continuous point. Common Gain anchor (100 trees, depth 4, eta .1), training-only imputation, half width ceil(anchor/2), canonical Gain and up to seven archive-generated alternatives, index=1000+UCI ID. One guard comparison and one final fit; anchor width one auto-retains without guard. First candidate in deterministic archive order breaks ties. Frozen related config: configs/context_review/transport_external.json.
estimand: Safe saved fraction U=(1-k/anchor_k)*I(no joint outer breach), raw scale 0..1. Relative tolerance .03 for macro OVR AUC and accuracy, plus .05 average precision if the proposal binary minority is <=.05. Compute per-fold paired difference, average feasible folds within each source, then equal-weight sources. Primary contrast continuous slack minus single point. Practical material advantage set BEFORE scoring at +0.05 U (five percentage points of safe anchor-feature removal, about one additional successful halving per ten decisions), with no increased mean breach rate. For evidence of superiority require primary 95% lower endpoint above +.05 and nonpositive empirical breach difference. Report inconclusive, negative or bounds honestly; no equivalence claim. If under two contributing sources only descriptive values.
uncertainty: 30,000 paired task-level percentile bootstrap draws, seed 33119; independent unit is source dataset, not fold or row. Report 95% interval, all per-source results, leave-one-source-out range, and win/tie/loss. Decision remains descriptive of a small purposive panel. Secondary prespecified contrasts vote-Gain, slack-Gain, slack-vote and point-Gain; same summaries without multiplicity adjustment. No pooling with the earlier panel.
resources: Execute each policy independently on one logical processor, rotate order by global fold ordinal modulo four, with preloaded data. Report actual elapsed seconds, nomination time, unique nomination mask counts, genuine refit counts and guard/outer breaches; posthoc diagnostic audit excluded. File locks must include every dependency used by the original implementation and this run, candidate and support choices, full unrounded class-probability arrays and outer row IDs for every method and reference. Commit a protocol before fitting and a full prediction artifact before opening the sealed outer outcomes.
